name: United Neighborhoods
description: United Neighborhoods was a Chicago-based coalition of predominantly Puerto Rican street gangs centered in the West Town and Wicker Park neighborhoods, active primarily during the 1970s and 1980s. Member factions included the La Familia, Spaulding, Clemente, Bucktown, and Anderson sections of the Warlords, as well as the YBO (Yates Boys). The alliance predated the People/Folk split and by the early 1980s had become majority aligned with the People Nation.
